title: Sidebar + fluid content
summary: A fixed sidebar and a flexible main column in two values.
explanation: grid-template-columns: 200px 1fr gives a fixed column and one that takes everything left. fr units share free space after fixed sizes are placed.
min-width: 0 on the content column lets wide content (code, long URLs) shrink or scroll instead of blowing the column out.
tryThis: Swap the columns to 1fr 200px and add order: -1 to .content.

children.text: The content column takes all remaining width. Resize the preview to see it flex.
